fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that sends Accept-Encoding can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.

rows.role_title: President of the African National Congress
rows.text: In the opening address dated Durban, 2 July 1991, Oliver Tambo recalls being struck by a stroke on the eve of the Harare Declaration's adoption, says the Deputy President (footnoted as Nelson Mandela) will continue the report, and ends by thanking all who helped make 'my Presidency' a worthwhile experience for him.

locator.section: Heading and dateline; closing paragraphs before 'Unity of the ANC' and the final paragraph; footnote 2

rows.role_title: Deputy President of the African National Congress
rows.text: The address's salutation names 'Comrade Nelson Mandela, Deputy President of the ANC'.
